name: semble-installable-mcp-launch-profiles
instr:
semble does not support reusable named local launch profiles for consistent content scope, snippet limits, and local-only policy across installation, console startup, and MCP use. Add profiles with provenance inspection and isolated per-call overrides without changing profile-free behavior.

`Profile`, `EffectiveProfile`, `ProfileError`, `load_profile`, and `resolve_profile` are public from `semble`. Resolution is immutable, normalizes duplicate content in `ContentType` declaration order, and records each winning source. Every surface uses per-call selection, startup selection, named profile, then built-in default precedence.

Load only from the explicit local directory. A profile is stored as `<directory>/<name>.json` and loaded as JSON. Missing profiles identify the requested name and resolved path. Malformed or invalid profiles produce no partial value. Report every invalid public field deterministically before server startup, repository-index access, or configuration mutation.

Search and find-related independently apply effective defaults and isolated overrides, accept paths passed between them, preserve established result and empty-result shapes, and provide stable JSONable inspection without filesystem contents. Later omitted-value calls retain unchanged server defaults after conflicting overrides.
